dedupe_keys.name: podil obydlenych domu dle pripojeni na kanalizaci

description: Podíl obydlených domů dle připojení na kanalizaci is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Královéhradecký kraj. Data set with spatial localization of the share of inhabited houses according to the connection to the sewerage system in municipalities in the Hradec Králové Region. The source of the data is the Department of Regional Development, Grants and Subsidies of the Regional Authority of the Hradec Králové Region. Coverage: Královéhradecký kraj. The portal shows the English title as "Share of inhabited houses by connection to sewerage" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Královéhradecký kraj. Its keywords include Kanalizace, Domy, Podíl, Královéhradecký kraj. The listing shows 6 download or service links in KML, ZIP, HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/70889546/05c03b1b313579b165a33bdf5844a6ca/distribuce/416d5053b703d22b33037f04249b7411/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
